title: Following another into a mistake
literal_meaning: With the otter, the wildcat goes wild!
explanation: Someone follows another’s lead into a mistake. The animal scene makes imitation look foolish.
meaning_odia: ଅନ୍ୟ ଜଣଙ୍କ ବୁଦ୍ଧିରେ ପଡ଼ି ନିଜେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଭୁଲ କରିବା।
usage_example: One colleague starts an ill-judged prank; another joins without thinking through the consequences. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
